Fonts for the Darklands+ interface and the crisp game text, all under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1 (the OFL*.txt files beside them):

  EBGaramond-Medium.ttf, EBGaramond-SemiBold.ttf   EB Garamond (OFL.txt)
  Alegreya-Medium.ttf                              Alegreya, latin subset (OFL-alegreya.txt)
  AtkinsonHyperlegible-Regular.ttf                 Atkinson Hyperlegible, latin subset (OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible.txt)
  IMFellEnglish-Regular.ttf                        IM FELL English, latin subset (OFL-im-fell-english.txt)
  MedievalSharp-Regular.ttf                        MedievalSharp, latin subset (OFL-medievalsharp.txt)
  DLFraktur-Regular.ttf                            a latin subset of UnifrakturMaguntia, renamed
                                                   "DL Fraktur" because "UnifrakturMaguntia" is a
                                                   Reserved Font Name (OFL-unifrakturmaguntia.txt)

The subsets come from the Fontsource packages (npm @fontsource/*), converted from WOFF to TTF.
